+                    value = value.lstrip('0')
+                sysinfo_facts[fact] = value
+

diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py b/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py
index 0a546f1..4fdbc9f 100644
--- a/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py
+++ b/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_linux.py
@@ -197,3 +197,65 @@ class TestFactsLinuxHardwareGetMountFacts(unittest.TestCase):
         lh = linux.LinuxHardware(module=module, load_on_init=False)
         sg_inq_serial = lh._get_sg_inq_serial('/usr/bin/sg_inq', 'nvme0n1')
         self.assertEqual(sg_inq_serial, None)
+
+
+class TestFactsLinuxHardwareGetSysinfoFacts(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module=Mock(), load_on_init=False)
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=False)
+    def test_absent_sysinfo(self, mock_exists):
+        self.assertEqual(self.hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {})
+        mock_exists.assert_called_once_with('/proc/sysinfo')
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_file_lines', return_value=[
+        'Manufacturer: IBM',
+        'Type: 3906',
+        'Sequence Code: 0000123456',
+        'LPAR Number: 1',
+    ])
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=True)
+    def test_sysinfo_fields(self, mock_exists, mock_lines):
+        self.assertEqual(self.hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM',
+            'product_name': '3906',
+            'product_serial': '123456',
+            'product_version': 'NA',
+            'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
+        mock_lines.assert_called_once_with('/proc/sysinfo')
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_file_lines', return_value=[])
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.os.path.exists', return_value=True)
+    def test_present_sysinfo_without_known_fields(self, mock_exists, mock_lines):
+        self.assertEqual(self.hardware.get_sysinfo_facts(), {
+            'system_vendor': 'NA',
+            'product_name': 'NA',
+            'product_serial': 'NA',
+            'product_version': 'NA',
+            'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
+
+    @patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.linux.get_best_parsable_locale', return_value='C')
+    def test_populate_uses_sysinfo_identity(self, mock_locale):
+        self.hardware.get_cpu_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+        self.hardware.get_memory_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+        self.hardware.get_dmi_facts = Mock(return_value={
+            'system_vendor': 'NA', 'product_name': 'NA', 'product_serial': 'NA',
+        })
+        self.hardware.get_sysinfo_facts = Mock(return_value={
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM', 'product_name': '3906', 'product_serial': '123456',
+            'product_version': 'NA', 'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
+        self.hardware.get_device_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+        self.hardware.get_uptime_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+        self.hardware.get_lvm_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+        self.hardware.get_mount_facts = Mock(return_value={})
+
+        facts = self.hardware.populate()
+
+        self.assertEqual(facts, {
+            'system_vendor': 'IBM', 'product_name': '3906', 'product_serial': '123456',
+            'product_version': 'NA', 'product_uuid': 'NA',
+        })
